newsitem.title: USA: Duff rates MCI shelf debt single-A.
newsitem.headline: Duff rates MCI shelf debt single-A.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Wednesday it assigned a single-A rating to MCI Communications Corp's $1 billion shelf registration for senior unsecured debt.
Duff said MCI is expected to use proceeds from the offering for general corporate purposes.
"Credit protection measures at MCI Communications remains very strong within its current rating category," Duff said in a statement.
It added that MCI continues to grow aggressively its non-core businesses such as cellular, local telecommunications and information technology.
MCI, a diversified communications company with 1995 revenues of $15.3 billion, is the second-largest U.S. long distance carrier.
